script: Every big journey begins with one small step. You do not need to have everything figured out today. You only need to begin. Think about a runner training for a marathon. On the first day, they cannot run forty kilometres. But they put on their shoes and run around the block. The next week, they run a little further. Progress is quiet and slow, and most days nobody notices it. Then one day, they cross the finish line. Your goals work the same way. Write one page. Learn one new word. Save one coin. Small actions, repeated every day, build a life you can be proud of. So close your eyes, take a deep breath, and take your first step today.
